crn.seed_derivation: sha256(tag|rid|j|world_seed_salt) -> 31-bit; independent of pick and of budget
crn.witness: afterstate deck-order hash asserted equal across the two picks for every world (crn_verified)

execution.backend_resolution: resolved at launch by rust_world_search.resolve_backend (escape hatch: CARC_PROBE_FORCE_PYTHON=1)
execution.continuation_tree_policy: PERSISTING — the playout calls best_action(), which never clears NeuralMCTS._nodes, so ONE tree spans every ply to terminal. On the rust backend this is carc_rs.PersistentSearcher via rust_agent.RustCarryClairvoyantAgent, NOT MirrorState.search_single (which is fresh-tree only and would be a different player).

gap_status.gap1_search_seed: CLOSED — measurement/rustport_p6/GAP1_SEED_INVARIANCE.json; the continuation's playout_seed is inert on this path
gap_status.gap2_reuse_tree: CLOSED 2026-08-02 (rustport P6) — and NOT inert here: this harness's continuation is a PERSISTING-TREE search. carc_rs.PersistentSearcher supplies it; measurement/rustport_p6/GATE_GAP2_PERSISTENT.json
gap_status.gap3_evaluator_injection: OPEN, enforced — search_config_rs and RustCarryClairvoyantAgent both raise

execution.identity_gate: measurement/rustport_p6/GATE_ORACLE_PILOT_BACKEND.json — this harness's own _process record, python vs rust, every non-timing field as raw f64 bits
execution.seam: ONE determinized world's search (fair_agent.search_one_world -> MirrorState.search_single). Determinization draw, pooling (_merge_root_stats) and decision rule (pooled_q_argmax) stay in Python and are the SAME function objects on both backends.
execution.threads_note: per-world search_single is SINGLE-THREADED; these probes are game-parallel farms, so rust_threads applies only to the whole-agent parity check

goal: Convert CL-070's 'the move changed' into 'the move improved' on a 20-position pilot, and measure the world-CRN variance reduction that decides whether the full ~652-position probe is powered.

binary_sha_within_box.note: compared WITHIN a host only — never across (JCZ §0.F.2c: the .so is not machine-reproducible). A box with no sha recorded contributes nothing and is not counted as evidence.

source.reported_delta: V(pick_b) - V(pick_a) == V(played) - V(best), engine points, root_player's seat

merge.note: A TWO-BOX merge of per-chunk legs. Counters are summed; gate-addressed fields were asserted IDENTICAL across chunks before being carried. Per-chunk values are below. wall_secs is a SUM across chunks that ran on different boxes and possibly concurrently — it is NOT a wall clock and is not the cost currency of record (DESIGN §7 costs from elapsed_secs).

oracle.definition: mean over M sampled deck completions of the TERMINAL engine score margin (root-player POV, points) after playing the afterstate out with the continuation policy on both seats
pilot_only_caveats: oracle_sims is far below the champion's own budget — weak-continuation bias
